name: Ramblr
author: nixfred
description: Ramblr room transcription on your bar: listening or muted at a glance, which mic, lines today. Click to mute or unmute (muted stops the recorder).

barWidget.description: A mic dot: teal and pulsing while Ramblr listens, magenta with a slash when muted, amber when it fell back to another mic, dim when the service is down. Click toggles mute.

schema.label: Refresh (seconds)
schema.description: How often the bar reads Ramblr's state.
